verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was to me, “…”
verses.2: The son of man was raised up among the people of Israel. You said to them, “Behold, I will do this and that to you.” But O LORD, the people of Israel were evil people. They had been evil before they were born.
verses.3: You shall eat the milk, and you shall chew on the cheese. The healthy ones shall sacrifice their animals; the sick ones shall not be harmed.
verses.4: Do not strengthen those who are weak, and do not heal those who are sick. Do not protect those who are injured, and do not accept those who are rejected by others. Do not try to save those who are destroyed. Strengthen them with kindness and compassion.
verses.5: And they were brought forth from the womb of their mothers, and they became food for all living beings in the field. And they were brought forth.
verses.6: My thorns are scattered across all the mountains, and on every high hill and every slope of the land. My thorns are everywhere, and there is no one who can pick them or pluck them from the ground.
verses.7: Therefore, the righteous heard the words of Jehovah.
verses.8: May my Lord, Jehovah, have mercy on me! If not, then may those who are evil do us harm. May they not take our possessions as food for all the creatures in the field. They should not take our possessions from us. But those who are evil will harm them and also our possessions.
verses.9: Therefore, the wicked heard the words of Jehovah.
verses.10: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will take my flock from their mouths. I will save my sheep from their evil actions. The wicked will no longer harm them. I will protect my sheep from them, so that they will not become food for them.”
verses.11: For thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I am here; I will demand my own from you, and I will avenge myself.”
verses.12: On the day of their creation, they were scattered throughout the universe. Thus, I gathered my flock together and saved them from all those places where they were lost on that day of clouds and darkness.
verses.13: And they came out from among the nations, and they settled in various lands. They brought them to their own land, and they planted them in the hills of Israel, along with all the other places on this earth.
verses.14: In good times, I will bless them; in the mountains of Israel, they will be blessed. There, they will enjoy good times and prosperity. In times of trouble, I will bring them down to the mountains of Israel.
verses.15: I will scatter them, and I will destroy them. May the Lord do so, O God!
verses.16: I will take back what has been taken away from me, and I will restore what has been rejected. I will strengthen those who are weak, and I will enhance those who are weak. I will destroy those who are strong through judgment.
verses.17: And I will give you the spoils, as my Lord Jehovah said. I will judge between the cattle and the wild animals.
verses.18: Those who are evil among you will become good. And those who are more evil than you will be destroyed by their own feet. They will drink from the water, and those who remain alive will be saved by their own feet.
verses.19: And I will break your legs, so that they will be broken; and I will tear apart your feet, so that they will be torn apart.
verses.20: Therefore, this is what the Lord Jehovah said to them: “I am here; I will judge between Sheh Birya and Sheh Razah.”
verses.21: In both sides and on the edges, they will be covered; in your ears, all the sounds will be mixed together until they are spread out to the ends.
verses.22: And I have saved my people. There will no longer be any need for judgment or punishment. I have judged between each one of them.
verses.23: And I will set up one of them as a ruler, and the other as his servant. David, my servant, will rule over them, and he will be their ruler.
verses.24: And I, the LORD, will be their God. And my servant David will reign over them. I, the LORD, have spoken.
verses.25: And I made a covenant of peace with them. I removed all evil from the land, so that they could live in safety by the sea, and they could also live in the forests.
verses.26: And I will give them and their surroundings blessings. I will also bring down the rain at that time, in a time of blessing.
verses.27: And He gave the land of the wilderness its fruits. The earth will give forth its crops, and they will live securely on their land. They will know that I, Jehovah, will break the power of those who serve evil. I will save them from the hands of their enemies.
verses.28: And there will no longer be any nations or tribes in the world. The earth will not be able to produce anything to eat. They will live in peace, without any fear.
verses.29: And I prepared for them a place where they could live in peace. They would no longer suffer from hunger on this land, and they would no longer be subjected to the cruel treatment of those who oppress them.
verses.30: And they shall know that I, the LORD their God, am with them. And this people, the children of Israel, shall praise the name of the LORD. Amen!
verses.31: And I will give you sheep from my flock. You are my gods, say the Lord God.
